ChangeLog: V5 Changelog -> Added a whole new Keybinds page to bind most useful toggles and buttons to a key. -> Added Stack Moves setting to No Moves Cooldown, if enabled you will be able to stack moves like using 10 Kamehamehas in half a second (normal behavior), if disabled then you can't stack them, you can only use that move one time at once, but after the move ends you can use it again without any cooldown. -> Added Auto Hop setting to Auto Collect Dragon Balls. -> Added a multi-select Target Dropdown in Auto page and in all sections that had a target textbox. -> Added Use Moves toggle and Moves dropdown in Auto page. Also very strong if combined with No Moves Cooldown. -> Added Move Use Delay slider, only used if No Moves Cooldown and Stack Moves are enabled. -> Added Rotation Mode dropdown with Above, Behind, Front and Orbit modes in Auto page. -> Added Distance slider in Auto page. -> Added Target Resolver dropdown in auto page and aimbot section with "Closest" and "Lowest HP" options. -> Added Punch Delay slider in Auto page. -> Added Max Distance slider to Auto Farm settings. -> Added Auto Transform toggle with "Only While Auto" setting in Auto page. -> Added Farm Bosses setting in auto page, auto farm section. -> Added Interval setting to Melee Kill Aura. -> Added Escape toggle in Pause Settings section, if enabled, when in Pause state, now you will travel randomly downwards or upwards so you don't stand still near the enemy. -> Added Auto Charge and its settings in Misc page. -> Added Enemies ESP in Visuals page. -> Added NPCs and Enemies teleport dropdowns in Teleports page. -> Added Entities Render Distance in Visuals page, Performance section. -> Added UI Size X and UI Size Y in Settings page, they auto save and do not save with configs. -> Added Delete AutoLoad Configuration button in Settings page. -> Added FPS Cap slider in Performance section. -> Added Disable 3D Rendering toggle in Performance section. -> Added Map Objects dropdown, can remove Trees, Fire Effects, Other Objects, Particles and Shadows for better FPS in Performance section. -> Added Render setting in Hitbox Expander. -> Added Only NPCs setting in Hitbox Expander. -> Added Show Feature Descriptions toggle in Settings page. -> Added UnHook button in Settings page. -> Added View Changelog button in the new Changelog section in Settings page, now you also get a notification if a new version gets detected (only one time). -> Added value suffixes like "%" and " s" to sliders where it makes sense, so many sliders are easier to read. -> Added Amberfall, Neon Tide, Verdant Glass, Midnight Prism, Frozen Aurora and Opaline Halo UI Themes. -> Added an additional fallback source when loading the script in case the primary HTTP request fails or that website is down. -> Added notification if the UI library failed to load and you will be able to execute again after. -> Increased maximum and default values of Pause Interval and Pause Time. -> Improved dropdown config loading a lot, especially for multi-dropdowns, selected values should now load properly. -> Improved/reworked layout of the Main page, Auto page and some other places. -> Improved Auto Quest. -> Updated visuals like Dragon Balls ESP to match DBZFS REMASTERED ESPs style. -> Auto Quest, No Ki Blasts Cooldown, Ki Kill Aura and Auto Stats now work again. -> In PC, No Slow and No Ki Blast Cooldown now uses your actual Ki Blast in-game bind instead of hardcoded V key. -> After a game update, you can decide to execute or not, instead of execution being disabled. -> Converted all the buttons of Earth teleports and Otherworld teleports into 2 dropdowns. -> Made some stuff and combat safer, and combat now uses combos. -> Changed the movement when traveling to enemies, now more stable. -> Removed an old very resource hungry part of the script, so performance should be better. -> Removed Auto Shenron and XP Gems ESP (both useless). -> Optimized a very resource hungry part of the script. -> All rotation modes now get a little jitter applied. -> Changed dead enemy detection to a more reliable method. -> Pending travels to enemies now get canceled if the auto gets disabled. -> Made settings of some features hide if the feature is disabled. -> Anti AFK and Auto Farm Only NPCs are now enabled by default. -> Only NPCs toggles now have a more accurate and improved NPC detection that also excludes quest NPCs. -> Punch Type now has effect in Auto Quest too. -> Fixed any feature that looked for targets like Auto Farm, Enemies ESP, etc not detecting the Ape boss. -> Fixed the script making the game error, causing many stuff to not load if the script was executed when the game was loading. -> Fixed Auto Farm not getting targets that are too far away due to game internal changes. -> Fixed setting Pause Time to 0 completely pausing Auto Farm forever. -> Fixed memory leak in No Slow. -> Fixed some bugs in Hitbox Expander. -> Fixed error in Auto Collect Drops. -> Fixed Target Teleport erroring if the target was too far away. -> Fixed Auto Farm not detecting some players and fully fixed player detection (in Target Teleport too). -> Fixed Random Auto Farm toggle sharing the same configuration flag as normal Auto Farm. -> Other minor improvements, fixes, changes, code cleanup and renamed a few feature titles/descriptions.
